remarks: Beautifully designed 1,962 sq ft home with a unique rear-attached garage, offering standout curb appeal and bright, inviting living spaces. The open-concept main floor is perfect for both relaxing and entertaining, featuring a front great room with a cozy fireplace, open-to-below design, and large windows for abundant natural light. The adjoining nook is ideal for dining or casual gatherings.  The chef-inspired kitchen showcases a rare double island, pendant lighting, Silgranit undermount sink, modern hood fan, full-height tile backsplash, built-in microwave, and upgraded soft-close cabinetry with a walk-through pantry. A covered side deck, roughed in for a future gas line, is accessible from the kitchen. Upstairs includes a spacious flex room, laundry, two bedrooms, and a full bath. The primary suite features a 5-piece ensuite with freestanding tub, separate shower, double sinks, and walk-in closet. (id:67522)
